item.title: RTT: Rif. 6269_All. 1 - Synthesis and characterization of new polymers from renewable sources for biomedical applications and food packaging (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The research activity will focus on the melt-state synthesis—via polycondensation and ring-opening polymerization (ROP)—and the characterization (in the melt, in the solid state, and in solution) of new polymers derived from renewable sources, particularly agri-food waste. These materials are intended for biomedical applications (tissue engineering, controlled drug delivery systems, and sustainable packaging with intrinsic antimicrobial properties) as well as for the development of sustainable, active food packaging. The research aims to establish structure-property relationships that are fundamental to designing new materials for specific applications. Teaching activities, student support,…
